Desktop Similar pane
similar command — b2-desktop/src/commands.rs

span.p: Vault::similar(note_ref, limit)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
grade = recorded embed_model_id is not the fake's —
judged on the RECORDED space (db::recorded_embedder),
not the injected embedder, so a fake-opened read
of a real-embedded vault still grades

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
anchor is an inventoried resource?
(resource::doc_kind + db::resource_detail)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Error::ResourceUnsupported —
honest ‘not yet’, never an empty list
(resources gain discovery with chunks+centroids)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
resolve_ref → anchor path;
Error::NoteNotFound for an unknown ref

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
limit is 0, or no embeddings table
(db::embedding_space_exists)?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
serve nothing — there is
nothing to search from

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
load the anchor's stored chunk vectors
db::note_chunk_vectors — re-embeds nothing

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
centroid_of(anchor vectors) —
computed in-process (an anchor mid-embed
discovers from what it has); any vectors?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
exclusion set = graph::reachable_within(anchor, 1):
the anchor + its direct neighbours, undirected
(EXCLUDE_HOPS = 1 keeps triadic-closure
candidates two hops out in the pool)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STAGE 1 — coarse, O(notes):
db::for_each_note_centroid streams every
(note, centroid); excluded notes skipped up front
so they never occupy a shortlist slot;
embed::l2_sq(anchor centroid, note centroid)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: sort nearest-first, ties by path

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
shortlist = max(limit × SHORTLIST_PER_RESULT,
SHORTLIST_MIN) = max(limit × 20, 200)
— a recall device, never a quality gate (GH #192)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
sort by best-pair distance, ties by path
— the served order (and, below, the z order:
one number, three names)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
grade, and scored population ≥
STATS_MIN_POPULATION (12), and sd > 0?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
z = (mean − d) / sd per candidate,
over the scored best-passage distances —
the strength band's input, gating nothing
(ADR-0014)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
no z — the list is served ungraded
and a surface must say so

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
take(limit) → CandidateNote:
score = −√(best-pair d²), the evidence
chunk id, z if graded

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CLI: score, name, path, evidence line,
plus the ‘commit one with b2 link …’ nudge;
empty list → two honest empty states,
neither claiming ‘nothing relates’ (GH #197)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Desktop card: strengthBand(z) dots —
ui/src/strength.ts; a null z paints no band
and the pane carries the ungraded caveat
